title: Libre 2 Connection issues
symptom: Libre 2 sensor has been disconnecting continuously, losing connection all the time since September 22nd, across three different sensors. The user uses Librelink and Xdrip+ (with OOP2) simultaneously on a Xiaomi Poco X6 Pro, which worked fine for the previous 10 months.
evidence_quote: Since that date, Libre 2 sensor has been disconnecting continously, loosing connection all the time.
